examples.text: Het concert was zo populair dat alle tickets binnen een paar uur waren uitverkocht.
examples.translation: The concert was so popular that all the tickets were sold out within a few hours.
examples.english: The concert was so popular that all the tickets were sold out within a few hours.

examples.text: De winkel uitverkoopt vaak snel tijdens de uitverkoopperiode.
examples.translation: The store sells out quickly during the sale period.
examples.english: The store sells out quickly during the sale period.

examples.text: Wees er snel bij, want deze speciale aanbieding zal snel uitverkopen!
examples.translation: Act quickly, as this special offer will sell out fast!
examples.english: Act quickly, as this special offer will sell out fast!
